blocks.text: 賣問我問我原因 咱心內空虛
blocks.spelling: mái mn̄g guá mn̄g guá guân-in lán sim-lāi khang-hi

blocks.text: 賣問我問我名字 那張舊相片
blocks.spelling: mái mn̄g guá mn̄g guá miâ-lī hit tiunn kū siòng-phìnn

blocks.text: 是汝 迷人的香味 是汝 美麗的眼神
blocks.spelling: sī lí bê lâng ê phang-bī sī lí bí-lē ê gán-sîn

blocks.text: 無聲的所在風底吹 我甲汝攏無講話
blocks.spelling: bô-siann ê sóo-tsāi hong té tshue guá kah lí lóng bô kóng-uē

blocks.text: 無聲的所在心底飛 海風欲帶咱去哪
blocks.spelling: bô-siann ê sóo-tsāi sim té pue hái-hong beh tuà lán khì tuī
